title: Independent inputs for the naming gate: the technique list counts once, and a single name must beat the combiner's null option
parent: product_external_taa_2026-10-27 (docs 21.3.26: two genuine wrong names of the procedure-text core on the external benchmarks); attribution_procedure_core_2026-10-26 (the defaults this changes)
request: the product owner asked to fix the two genuine wrong names (2026-10-27)
design_source: the two external cases themselves (development data for these rules from now on): an AthenaBench APT41 profile named Lazarus Group at combiner probability 0.93 with no software and no behaviour match, its two independent families being technique overlap and the country model, which reads the same accepted technique list; a CTIBench Lazarus report named Storm-1811 at 0.36 through a Black Basta mention that the report attributes to other actors, with the combiner's null probability 0.62 above the leader's. Each rule was written from its mechanism, not from a threshold between cases.

rules.technique_list_one_family: MaturityThresholds.technique_list_one_family (ATTRIBUTION_TECHNIQUE_LIST_ONE_FAMILY): the families technique_overlap, campaign, learned_profile and origin (attribution.TECHNIQUE_LIST_FAMILIES) all read the accepted technique list (the learned profiles and the country model also read the analyst's stated context, which strategic_context and motivation_alignment count on their own) and count as one family in the independent-family check; below the minimum of 2 the leader goes to unresolved_activity_cluster before any other step (no single name, no cluster name). The fusion, the combiner's inputs and the ranking do not change (the family map of session.py is untouched; the change is in the gate).
rules.hypothesis_above_null: MaturityThresholds.hypothesis_above_null (ATTRIBUTION_HYPOTHESIS_ABOVE_NULL): a single name also needs the combiner's leader probability above its null ('none of these') probability; a held leader falls through to the documented-cluster step as under the naming floor. Without an active combiner the rule does not apply.

measured_before_registration: exact offline replay (scripts/naming_rules_replay.py) over the recorded procedure-core runs: design seeds 41/53, seed 7, gate seeds 109/113/127, CTI-HAL (names, as reported, tradecraft), Elastic (strict, names, tradecraft) and the two external runs. technique list once: holds the APT41 -> Lazarus Group name and 11 of 237 correct ATT&CK fold names (41: 3, 53: 2, 7: 3, 109: 2, 113: 0, 127: 1), nothing on CTI-HAL, Elastic or the correct external names. above null: holds the Lazarus -> Storm-1811 name, one correct CTI-HAL name (FIN7, FIREEYE6, p 0.42 vs null 0.54; 12 -> 11 named in the headline reading, 18 = 18 as reported) and one correct CTIBench name (Lazarus, p 0.34 vs 0.54); nothing on the folds. No cluster fall-through anywhere; no removed-actor name held or added.

confirmation.runs: with both rules on (the new defaults), local pipeline, no API key, local LLM off: AthenaBench and CTIBench TAA as in product_external_taa_2026-10-27, CTI-HAL anonymised headline, design seed 41 (data/audits/naming_rules/run.sh)
confirmation.criterion: the replay of the runs made without the rules matches the runs made with them row for row (stage and named members; naming_rules_replay.py --on); the two wrong names are held; top-1 and every rank are unchanged

adoption: both rules on by default when the confirmation holds (the request was to fix the names, and the rules can only remove names: the naming gate cannot get worse except through the documented-cluster fall-through, which the replay covers); each is a setting for rollback. No fresh fold seeds: the rules leave every ranking unchanged and their cost on the folds is measured on six seeds.
caveats: the rules were designed from the two cases they fix, so the external sets no longer measure them; a claim about unseen text needs new data. The Black Basta mention is a software-extraction problem (a mention attributed to other actors is read as use), which the null rule catches only because the combiner was unsure; a confident misread mention would still name. The technique-list rule costs names that ATT&CK's own phrasing makes right on the folds, where technique lists work best; on real reports no correct name rested on the technique list alone.
cost: laptop only, no API credit, about 1.5 hours of runs
